      Review-Fenster: 01.06.2026 - 22.08.2026

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 24.07.2026 - 12.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Jaroslav Holaň_, 24.07.2026, 1/5: "Unfortunately, the app only offers several dark themes. This makes it practically unusable for me because I need a light theme. A light interface is easier for me to read during the day, especially outdoors or in a well-lit room. Dark themes are less comfortable for my eyes, make navigation more difficult, and cause fatigue during longer use. I would therefore appreciate a proper light theme, ideally with the option to follow the phone’s system settings automatically."
            2. _Parth Magar_, 12.08.2026, 4/5: "hey app is just awesome but there is bug i am using widgets of habit the streak shown in app is different from the widgets streak keep both same..."
